references.role: Approved homepage context with public map reference and illustrative data; no private account screenshot.

prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: approval design board for Rakky Ride driver "Manage services" flow.
Primary request: redesign the controls revealed by Manage on the driver's homepage. Keep the established small-font white/forest-green visual system. Make the result organized, concise and polished, with clearer consent and application actions.
Reference image: supplied prior approved Driver home design, used only as the underlying home visual context. It contains a public real map reference and illustrative zero earnings, no private driver information. Preserve that real map imagery in the small visible background areas; never invent an illustrated map. Do not change the underlying home layout.
Composition: two complete straight-on mobile screens, same size about 390x844 logical pixels, side by side on pale silver board, slim rounded screen outlines, no phone hardware, no perspective. Left shows "Manage services" sheet; right shows the withdrawal confirmation over that same sheet. Small readable Inter-like type: page title 15px, labels 13–14px, helpers 12–13px, small conventional line icons 16–18px. Compact rounded 12px cards, 24px top sheet corners, fine separators, at least 44px control touch areas. Palette forest green #176B17, charcoal #141A14, muted #586253, silver #EEF1EC, white, pale mint #EAF5E5. Red only for consent withdrawal and its warning.
LEFT SCREEN:
Underlying Driver home from reference visible behind a subtle neutral scrim in the top 20 percent. On top, a white modal bottom sheet fills bottom 80 percent, fully shows all primary controls, no clutter. Tiny handle, compact title row "Manage services" with 44px X close control.
Short subtitle "Choose which new requests you receive."
First service card:
header row small mint square and green car outline, "Passenger rides", small green "Approved" badge.
Next row "Receive requests" with an ON green switch at right; helper below "New passenger ride requests."
Fine divider.
One concise consent row: small shield-check outline, "Consent accepted", and red text action "Withdraw" at right. This is secondary and clearly distinct from the request toggle.
Second service card:
header row small silver square and muted box outline, "Courier deliveries", small neutral "Not requested" badge.
Next row "Receive requests" and visibly disabled gray OFF switch.
Short helper "Apply to start courier deliveries."
Under the cards, small information icon and helper "Changes affect new requests. Complete accepted jobs."
One small green caption "Changes save automatically."
Bottom actions, full width:
green primary button, white text "Manage applications", small document outline.
Secondary text/outlined action with small refresh icon "Refresh status".
Comfortable bottom safe area and home indicator. Do not add extra Save or Done buttons because toggles already save immediately. Do not duplicate an Apply button inside the courier card.
RIGHT SCREEN:
Same Manage services screen underneath, dimmed lightly. Centered compact white confirmation dialog with 16px internal gutters, small red shield icon in soft red circle, title "Withdraw passenger consent?" at 15px.
Concise explanation, 13px: "Passenger requests will stop. To return, select this service and accept consent in Applications."
Small neutral informational line with icon: "Accepted jobs must still be completed."
Two full-width 44px buttons:
"Keep consent" solid forest green with white text (safe default).
"Withdraw consent" red outlined with red text (clearly consequential action).
No checkmark claiming it has already been withdrawn. No oversized warning illustration.
Constraints: this is a proposal, preserve real eligibility and review states. Requests toggle is enabled only for approved service with accepted consent. Do not imply changing request preferences withdraws consent. Don't promise reactivation without applying/accepting consent. No subscriptions, money claims, fabricated statistics, giant type, emoji, decorative art, extra functionality, watermarks, extra sections or long paragraphs. Render the exact specified text cleanly with no overlap, clipping or repetitions.
